solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Banks receive deposit of German cats

indicators.note: the banks take something deposited into them, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: banks are rows or tiers, as of seats or oars

explanation.surface: A financial picture: banks taking in a deposit from a German customer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Banks' and 'deposit' suggest money, but banks here are rows, TIERS, and the deposit is just G placed inside them.
explanation.definitionFit: Tigers are large wild felines, members of the cat family, so they are cats.

clue.text: Listen in illegally while lawyers eat and drink here

parts.note: to tap a phone is to listen in illegally
as can mean while, as in as I walked
the bar is the legal profession of barristers

explanation.surface: Lawyers are bugged while they eat and drink.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a description: a place to eat and drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A tapas bar is a Spanish-style venue serving small dishes and drinks, where people eat and drink.

clue.text: Sludge expected to cover toilet up is well worth the money

parts.note: goo is sticky sludge

indicators.note: the expected word wraps around the toilet piece

parts.note: due means expected, as in the train is due

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: lav is short for lavatory, a toilet

explanation.surface: A plumbing scene: sludge about to cover an upturned toilet, oddly called a bargain.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' reads the toilet word bottom to top; 'to cover' means the expected word wraps round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Good value describes something whose quality justifies its price, so well worth the money.

clue.text: Artist going round Italy's grand capital

indicators.note: the artist letters go round the other two letters

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
I is the international vehicle code for Italy
G is short for grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: A painter tours Italy's grand capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going round' puts IG inside RA.
explanation.definitionFit: Riga is the capital city of Latvia on the Baltic.

clue.text: American furious about active Nazis getting hold of essentially incalculable capital

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the word for furious is read backwards

parts.note: in American usage mad means angry or furious

indicators.note: the Nazis piece holds another piece inside it

parts.note: the SS was the Nazi paramilitary organisation

indicators.note: essentially means at its essence, the middle two letters of incalculable

explanation.surface: A grim history scene: an angry American and Nazis seizing something beyond reckoning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' reverses the American word for furious; 'essentially' takes the two central letters of incalculable, held by the Nazis abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Damascus is the capital city of Syria, one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities.

clue.text: Capital lager is brewed

indicators.note: brewed fits the beer in the surface and signals the letters being stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A city's beer is made locally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is part of the anagram fodder, not a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Algiers is the capital city of Algeria.

clue.text: Not having a party ruined oil capital

indicators.note: ruined suggests the letters of oil capital are wrecked and reassembled

explanation.surface: An oil-rich city is wrecked because nobody throws a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'party' means a political party, not a celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone apolitical has no political allegiance, belonging to no political party.

clue.text: Beaten tin with extended sides

parts.note: a can is a tin container

indicators.note: the sides of extended are its outer letters, first and last

explanation.surface: Tin was hammered and stretched at the edges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sides' takes ED, the outer letters of extended.
explanation.definitionFit: To be caned is to be beaten with a cane as a punishment.

clue.text: Capital loan keeping pressure on exchange rate at first

indicators.note: keeping means the loan word holds the other letters inside

parts.note: a sub is an advance or loan on wages
P is the symbol for pressure

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letters of exchange and rate

explanation.surface: Financial talk of a city loan held down by pressure on exchange rates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' is the dated adjective meaning excellent, not a city; a sub is a British word for an advance on wages.
explanation.definitionFit: Capital is an old-fashioned exclamation of approval meaning excellent or first-rate.

clue.text: Capital's wild animal

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters of animal running out of order

explanation.surface: A city's creature roams free.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', a link between definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Manila is the capital city of the Philippines.

clue.text: Pony beaten by criminals around Yankee capital

indicators.note: beaten means knocked about, so the letters of pony are shaken into a new order
the gang piece goes around the Yankee letter

parts.note: a gang is a group of criminals
Yankee is Y in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A cruel scene of a pony beaten by criminals near an American.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beaten' scrambles the horse word for the first four letters; 'around' wraps the criminals round the Yankee letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Pyongyang is the capital city of North Korea.

clue.text: Admit it hurts to reject groan- worthy joke

parts.note: ow is the cry meaning it hurts

indicators.note: rejecting here means throwing back, so the joke word is read backwards

parts.note: a pun is the classic joke that makes people groan

explanation.surface: Someone confesses that a terrible joke pains them and they want it scrapped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to reject' sends the joke word back to front after the cry of pain.
explanation.definitionFit: To own up is an idiom for confessing, so it means to admit something.

clue.text: Big car excellent for island capital

parts.note: an SUV is a sport utility vehicle, a big car
A, the top grade, stands for excellent

explanation.surface: A recommendation of a big car as ideal for driving round an island capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Suva is the capital of Fiji, a Pacific island nation, so an island capital.

clue.text: Team get a good result bringing back coloured snake

parts.note: a side is a sports team
to win is to get a good result

indicators.note: bringing back means the colour word is read in reverse

parts.note: red is a colour, so coloured gives red

explanation.surface: A sports team wins and comes home with a brightly coloured snake as a trophy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bringing back' turns RED into DER at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A sidewinder is a small rattlesnake of American deserts that moves sideways.

clue.text: Confinement among bird people ultimately unpleasant

parts.note: in can mean among, as in in the crowd
a tern is a seabird
men are people

indicators.note: ultimately takes the last letter of unpleasant

explanation.surface: Being caged among birds and people is unpleasant in the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Internment is the confining of people, often without trial, during wartime.

clue.text: American capital network beset by American traders trashing America initially

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded by, so the network letters sit inside the initials
initially takes the first letter of each of the four words before it

parts.note: LAN is a local area network

explanation.surface: A US capital's computer network is attacked by American traders badmouthing the country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes ATTA from American traders trashing America; 'beset by' puts LAN inside it. ATLANTA is the capital of the US state of Georgia.
explanation.definitionFit: Atlanta is the state capital of Georgia in the United States, so an American capital.

clue.text: Mountaineering centre cheerful after quiet climb

indicators.note: after places the cheerful word after the rest

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet

indicators.note: centre takes the middle two letters of the fourteen-letter word mountaineering

parts.note: up means cheerful, in good spirits

explanation.surface: A climbing centre feels cheerful after a hushed spell.
explanation.walkthrough: Mountaineering has fourteen letters, so its 'centre' is two letters; 'after' puts the cheerful word last.
explanation.definitionFit: To shin up is a phrasal verb for climbing using arms and legs, so it means to climb.

clue.text: Capital text winning a lawsuit

parts.note: up means ahead or winning, as in two goals up
per means a or each, as in once per day
a case is a lawsuit in court

explanation.surface: A message announcing victory in a court action.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a' gives PER, as in 'ten pounds a head'.
explanation.definitionFit: Uppercase letters are capitals, so uppercase is text in capital letters.

clue.text: Capital has less urban parts coming from the south

indicators.note: in a down clue coming from the south means read upwards, from bottom to top
parts means a stretch of letters is taken from within the phrase

explanation.surface: A city has fewer urban districts in the south.
explanation.walkthrough: 'parts' finds SLESSURB within 'has less urban'; 'coming from the south' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: Brussels is the capital of Belgium and seat of the European Union.

clue.text: Not quite officer sorts

indicators.note: not quite means the word falls short, losing its final letter

parts.note: a general is a senior army officer

explanation.surface: Someone almost made officer rank, described as a type.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not quite' drops the L from GENERAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Genera is the plural of genus, a biological category, so it means kinds or sorts.

clue.text: Upheaval at vicarage after golf is banned as a sin

indicators.note: an upheaval is a violent disturbance, so the letters are thrown into a new order
is banned means the golf letter is removed from vicarage

parts.note: golf is G in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Turmoil at the vicarage after a ban on golf is condemned as sinful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is banned' leaves VICARAE, which 'Upheaval' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Avarice, or greed, is one of the seven deadly sins.

clue.text: Run small van

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing
a camper is a camper van, a van fitted for living in

explanation.surface: An instruction to drive a little van.
explanation.definitionFit: To scamper is to run quickly with short light steps.

clue.text: Succeeded that woman's father as guide

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for succeeded in genealogies
her means that woman's
pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: Someone took over from a woman's father as guide.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherpas are Himalayan people famed as mountain guides and porters.

clue.text: Implement the last of many in battered chest

indicators.note: in places the last letter inside the anagram
battered means knocked about, so the letters of chest are rearranged
the last of takes the final letter of many

explanation.surface: An instruction to store the last of many items in a damaged chest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Implement' looks like a verb but is the noun for a tool. 'battered' makes SCTHE, which takes Y.
explanation.definitionFit: A scythe is a long-bladed farm tool for cutting grass, an implement.

clue.text: Capital in surprising change accepts golf tournament

indicators.note: accepts means the anagram takes another piece inside it
surprising suggests the letters of change are thrown into an unexpected order

parts.note: the Open is the famous golf championship

explanation.surface: A city surprisingly agrees to stage a golf event.
explanation.walkthrough: 'surprising' scrambles the word change, and 'accepts' lets the golf championship in after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Copenhagen is the capital city of Denmark.

clue.text: Place one inside gold dish

indicators.note: inside puts the one letter within the place letters

parts.note: PL is the abbreviation for place in addresses
I is the Roman numeral one
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: Put one item inside a golden dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilau is a rice dish cooked in stock with spices.

clue.text: Times editors regularly attack socialist leaders

indicators.note: leaders are the first letters of the four words before it

explanation.surface: Editors of The Times newspaper routinely attack socialist politicians.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Times' looks like the newspaper but is the definition: periods of history.
explanation.definitionFit: Eras are periods of history, and times can mean ages or epochs.

clue.text: Order car

explanation.surface: A command to buy a car.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a formal decree and the name of an Italian car maker.

clue.text: In Chantilly, you return a length of fabric

parts.note: Chantilly is in France, and tu is French for you

indicators.note: return means go back, so the length word is read backwards

parts.note: an ell is an old measure of cloth length

explanation.surface: Addressing a French lace-maker: give back a length of material.
explanation.walkthrough: Chantilly is a French town famous for lace, so its 'you' is TU; 'return' turns ELL into LLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Tulle is a fine netted material used for veils and ballet tutus, a kind of fabric.

clue.text: Secretly sought after soldier

parts.note: in means fashionable or sought after
a private is a soldier of the lowest rank

explanation.surface: A soldier is quietly in demand.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in private means doing it away from others, so secretly.

clue.text: European society accepts one coming in to fairly share capital

indicators.note: the two abbreviations take the rest inside them
the letter for one enters the word for fairly

parts.note: quite means fairly, as in quite good
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A European club admits a member so that capital is shared fairly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming in to' puts I inside QUITE, giving QUITIE; 'accepts' places that between E and S.
explanation.definitionFit: Equities are ordinary shares, the share capital of a company owned by shareholders.

clue.text: Capital busy with birds

parts.note: at can mean busy or engaged, as in at work
hens are birds

explanation.surface: A city teeming with birds.
explanation.definitionFit: Athens is the capital city of Greece.
